title: Will AI expose the rickety infrastructure of the internet?
slides: Will AI's hunger expose the internet's crumbling foundations?
Data centers now demand power grids never built for it
The bottleneck isn't chips — it's decades-old wiring
Your cloud costs may rise as utilities scramble
Check your region's grid capacity before scaling
thread_text:
1. The Grid Is the Real Bottleneck

Data centers are now demanding power grids never built for this scale. The bottleneck isn't chips — it's decades-old wiring that can't keep up.

2. Aging Infrastructure Can't Keep Up

Utilities are scrambling to upgrade transmission lines while AI's hunger grows. Your cloud costs may rise as they pass those expenses on.

3. Cloud Bills Are About to Jump

Companies scaling AI without checking regional grid capacity face delays and higher power costs. Some data centers are already waiting years for connections.

4. Check Before You Scale

Before expanding AI workloads, check your region's grid capacity. Utilities publish interconnection queues and capacity maps — most teams never look.

5. Test Your Region Today

Look up your local grid operator's capacity map and see if your data center region is constrained. Would you still scale there this quarter?
